text:
alex: Quick q — for the per-tenant cost card: how should we surface cache savings that come from shared prefetch layers vs route-local cache? Right now some tenants see negative token 'net' and product PMs hate it :grimacing:

maria: Are you talking about the global prefetch pool (batcher prewarm) vs per-route KV cache? do you have an example?

alex: Yeah. Example: route A hits prefetch that benefits A and B; our current ledger subtracts savings from whichever route triggered prefetch, so route B shows zero cost or negative. This breaks trust.

jamal: we've been using attribution heuristic: assign prefetch credit to the triggering route 100%. easy but wrong when shared. alternative is proportional split by subsequent hits.

sasha: UX idea: show two numbers — 'gross token cost' and 'credited cache savings (shared / local)'. let users expand to see provenance (prefetch id, window).

lee: can we compute proportional split in streaming? sounds heavy. what's the telemetry for tracing hits back to prefetch id?

jamal: we already emit event: cache_hit {prefetch_id, route, tenant, timestamp}. SQL to compute split (rough):
```
SELECT tenant, prefetch_id, count(*) as hits,
       sum(case when route=triggering_route then 1 else 0 end) as trigger_hits
FROM cache_hits
WHERE timestamp between X and Y
GROUP BY tenant, prefetch_id
```
then split credit = total_prefetch_cost * hits / total_hits

maria: that seems reasonable. but two concerns: sampling = 1/10k for perf, and "hits" across multiple tenants need per-tenant isolation.

alex: sampling is the big one. if we upscale sample to 1/100 we explode cost. can we estimate with bloom-filter approximations instead?

jamal: probabilistic counting could work (HyperLogLog for unique hiters), but we need counts not uniques. Count-min sketch maybe. has error but bounded.

sasha: for the console, maybe show 'estimated shared savings' with a confidence band and a tooltip explaining sampling and algorithm. PMs prefer transparency > exactness.

lee: rollout plan: feature flag per-org, default off. A small set of customers get 'split credit', others see current model. metrics to watch: perceived negative-cost alerts, billing delta, support tickets.

alex: agreed. also add a toggle in the console to 'show estimated split' so support can reproduce conversations.

devex-bot: Design doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/costs/shared-cache-attribution v1 draft

maria: I'll draft the API for the console — endpoint will return {gross_cost, cache_credit: {local, shared_estimate, confidence}}

jamal: one more: perf. prefer async job to compute nightly aggregates and a streaming approx for realtime card.

sasha: UX will mock with "confidence" pill and an explain link. I'll post mock tomorrow.

alex: awesome. can we set milestone for canary by next Friday? :calendar:

maria: yes. I'll open PR with API schema and sample payloads.

jamal: adding a note — bucket prefetch attribution by 1h window to limit churn.

lee: ping infra for storage needs — sample counts + sketches saved per-prefetch will add ~5-10% storage.

alex: thanks team — tagging @sasha @maria for follow-ups :pray:
